overview.title: Network Mapper — Overview
text: Hybrid Windows/Linux discovery and NetMap baseline capability.
Recommended flow: Discovery → host review → service/version scan → CVE correlation → save/use baseline.
Use the baseline in Digital Twin, baseline comparison and visualisation workflows.

discovery.title: Discovery
text: Windows and Linux retain their platform-specific discovery paths.
Review discovered hosts before deeper scans.

analysis.title: Services, versions and vulnerabilities
text: Service/version scanning runs on discovered hosts.
Vulnerability Analysis correlates service data with available local signatures/CVE data.
Treat matches as candidates until applicability and evidence are reviewed.

map.title: Map and presentation
text: Use node size, style, Fit and search/filter controls for presentation.
English uses Print, Send and Style.
Network Mapper discovers; Digital Twin models; Network Visualisation presents relationships.

handoff.title: Handoff to other CAMT capabilities
text: Save/export a NetMap baseline before comparison or downstream analysis.
Digital Twin can use network context for scenario projection and what-if analysis.
NetMap Baseline Comparator identifies added, removed and changed assets.
